Leaflet 1.9.4
https://leafletjs.com/
https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/tree/v1.9.4

Original distribution files downloaded from https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/.
License copied from the v1.9.4 source tag; see LICENSE in this directory.
These assets are served locally by SearchParty. Maps use OpenStreetMap standard
tiles with visible attribution, default browser HTTP caching, and no bulk or
offline prefetch. Tile service policy: https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/
The OpenStreetMap standard tile service is best-effort; select a suitable tile
provider before substantial public traffic. The URL is configured in SearchMap.tsx.
